title: Bench Labour Measured Net of Amounts Already Taken Off
content:
# Desk Standing Rule: Bench Labour Measured Net of Amounts Already Taken Off

Where a protection coverage answers for work on a piece at the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service, how the bench labour on the work order is measured turns on what has already been taken off that order and on how the coverage stands in the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans records.

## 1. Amounts already taken off, coverage in force

Where amounts have already been taken off the priced lines of the work order and the coverage stands in force, the bench labour is measured net of every amount already taken off the order, so that nothing is answered for twice.

## 2. Amounts already taken off, coverage out of good standing for a missed inspection

Where amounts have already been taken off the priced lines of the work order and the coverage stands out of good standing for a missed inspection, the bench labour is measured net of the amounts taken off under a member benefit alone.

## 3. Any other case

In any other case no such adjustment to the measurement is made.

## Condition table

| Amounts already taken off the work order | How the coverage stands | The measurement |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | in force | net of every amount already taken off the order |
| Yes | out of good standing for a missed inspection | net of the amounts taken off under a member benefit alone |
| Yes | any other standing | no such adjustment |
| No | in force | no such adjustment |
| No | out of good standing for a missed inspection | no such adjustment |

## Hypothetical readings

A work order carries bench labour of 800.00 USD booked, and 120.00 USD has been taken off it, of which 50.00 USD was taken off under a member benefit and 70.00 USD as a goodwill recovery. Where the coverage stands in force, the measured labour is 680.00 USD, net of all 120.00 USD. Where the coverage stands out of good standing for a missed inspection, the measured labour is 750.00 USD, net of the 50.00 USD taken off under a member benefit alone.
